text:
Maya (Recruiter): FYI — noticed 3 candidates from last week's onsites have no scorecards in the ATS. Looks like some interviewers submitted but nothing showed up. Anyone seen this?

Ethan (People Ops): :eyes: Can you list candidate IDs or links? Also, did we push the new scoring rubric yesterday? That might have changed form fields.

Maya (Recruiter): Here are the rows: CAND-9812, CAND-9819, CAND-9821. I asked two interviewers and they said they filled the form. One mentioned the form looked different mid-submission.

Priya (Hiring Manager): I rolled out the new rubric and short-form UI at ~09:10 this morning. I told interviewers in the doc but maybe the mapping wasn't backwards compatible. Link: https://redwood.docs/interviews/rubric-v2 

Sam (Eng Infra): Seeing a couple errors from the ATS webhook this morning around 09:12. Stacktrace snippet: 
```
POST /webhook/scorecard 500 InternalServerError
body: {"interview_id":"int-453","responses":{...}}
error: "SchemaMismatch: missing field 'overall_fit_v2' for mapper v2 -> v1"
```
Looks like the intake service still expects the old field names. :bug:

Maya (Recruiter): That matches timing. Interviewers who opened before the push maybe saved in old format, and others hit the new form. So some submissions hit the webhook with unexpected fields and were dropped?

Ethan (People Ops): Creating an ops ticket and tagging eng infra. We should also run a one-off job to reconcile the missing scorecards if possible. I'll open a ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/RECR-4123

Sam (Eng Infra): RECR-4123 assigned to me. Short-term fix: accept both v1 and v2 payloads in the mapper for 48 hours, log conversions. Long-term: add schema version header to the form. I'll push a patch to staging and monitor.

ats-bot: new deploy to staging succeeded: infra/scorecard-mapper v1.2.1 (deployed by sam)

Priya (Hiring Manager): Thanks. Two process things: 1) We should run a reconciliation to pull the dropped payloads from web server logs and attach them to the correct candidate. 2) Schedule a 30-min interviewer calibration and quick how-to on the new rubric so everyone uses the new fields consistently.

Maya (Recruiter): I can run outreach to the affected interviewers and get copies of what they submitted. For the calibration session, would next Wed 10:00am PT work? I can create a calendar invite and include the new rubric + a 5-min demo video.

Ethan (People Ops): Wed 10am PT works for me. Please include a short checklist for interviewers: (1) confirm form loaded fully before starting, (2) save drafts if stepping away, (3) always hit "finalize" button.

Sam (Eng Infra): I'll scope the log-replay job and share a small script to map old keys to new ones. ETA two business days.

Maya (Recruiter): Cool — I'll draft the invite: "Interviewer calibration + rubric v2 walk-through". Invite will include: rubric link, 5-min demo, FAQ, and how to report missing scorecards. Will also cc hiring managers so they can reinforce.

Priya (Hiring Manager): Please add a short standard message we can paste to interviewers who already submitted: "Thanks — we saw an issue with the scorecard form; can you please confirm submission or re-submit if you saw any errors?" Keeps it consistent.

Ethan (People Ops): I'll follow up with a short post-mortem in #people-ops after the fix and reconstruction. Include timeline, root cause, and steps to prevent recurrence.

Maya (Recruiter): Action items: Maya — outreach + invite; Sam — mapper patch + log replay script; Ethan — ops ticket + post-mortem; Priya — reinforce with hiring managers. I'll update RECR-4123 with progress. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng Infra): Noted. Will monitor for any further 500s and run the replay when we confirm the mapper tolerates both schemas.

ats-bot: RECR-4123 updated: assignee=Sam, status=In Progress

Maya (Recruiter): Invite sent for Wed 10:00am PT, calendar event includes rubric link and demo clip. I've also messaged the three interviewers directly and asked for copies of their submissions. Will post updates here when I get them.
